testcase.name: adequate stillness is different from insufficient observation
batch arrival cannot be used before receipt even with dense heart data
FIFO sizing honors requested low sampling rate and available capacity
replay uses recorded ticks generations arrival times and exact input snapshots
duplicate reversed invalid events do not inflate coverage or become stillness
five Hz coverage crosses boundaries without losing observed time
coverage has precise leading trailing overlap gaps and minute denominators
ninety five bins over forty five minutes cannot masquerade as full observation
suspend delayed FIFO samples are retained but future and unreliable samples are rejected
irregular event intervals preserve exact known time and never bridge long gaps
